what: one percent of a whole (0-100) as a ring that fills clockwise from the top, the number counting up in the centre and the label under it
use_when: an article states a percent with the % sign and that share is the whole story (turnout, approval, a part of a budget)
avoid_when: a count, not a percent (stat); several percents side by side (budget, bars); the tenths of a hundred the grid tells better (share)
rules: "gauge": one percent of a whole an article states with the % sign (value 62 means 62%), never computed; "suffix" replaces the % only when the whole is something else;
